rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person who translates text.

example.english: The translator helped us translate the contract into English.
example.traditional: 嗰位翻譯員幫我哋將份合約譯成英文。
example.jyutping: go2 wai6 faan1 jik6 jyun4 bong1 ngo5 dei6 zoeng1 fan6 hap6 joek3 jik6 sing4 jing1 man4

rows.note: Use this for a device or software tool that translates text rather than a human translator.

example.english: I used the translator on my phone to read the Japanese menu.
example.traditional: 我用手機入面個翻譯器睇日文菜單。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 sau2 gei1 jap6 min6 go3 faan1 jik6 hei3 tai2 jat6 man2 coi3 daan1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a computer program that converts code from one programming language into another.

example.english: This translator can convert this code into another language.
example.traditional: 呢個編譯器可以將呢段程式碼轉做另一種語言。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 pin1 jik6 hei3 ho2 ji5 zoeng1 nei1 dyun6 cing4 sik1 maa5 zyun2 zou6 ling6 jat1 zung2 jyu5 jin4
